title: Declare jsdom for the combined chase approval tests
public_pr_body:
The combined #161 branch includes #204's `@vitest-environment jsdom` approval-button test, but its manifest and lockfile do not declare jsdom. The CI web job fails at Unit tests after a clean install; the broader development snapshot had hidden the missing dependency.

Declare jsdom 30.1.3 as a development dependency and record its dependency tree in package-lock.json. Only these two files change; no tests or assertions are weakened.

Validation: a clean `npm ci` succeeded; jsdom resolves as 30.1.3; all 5,014 tests across 372 files passed, including the reviewed-text DOM test; typecheck passed. Production build and live browser/database suite were not run. Raw Actions log download is blocked by the environment's log-download host policy; failing step and branch contents were verified through GitHub API.
